app.name: WiskBot
chat.title: Chat
chat.emptyBody: Messages from this conversation appear here as the assistant responds.
chat.notice: Replies stream live from your configured provider.
chat.noProvider: No provider is enabled. Add one in Settings.
approval.waiting: Assistant is waiting for your approval
settings.title: Settings
settings.providersHelp: Keys are encrypted on this device and never shown again after saving.
settings.apiKeyHelp: Leave blank when editing to keep the stored key.
settings.keyRequired: This provider requires an API key.
settings.keyOptional: This provider does not require an API key.
settings.permissionsHelp: Read tools run once; all other risks ask for approval by default.
settings.allowedFoldersHelp: These are the only folders the assistant may list or read.
settings.resetKeyStoreDescription: This deletes every stored API key from this device.
settings.resetKeyStoreWarning: This is irreversible. You will need to enter all API keys again.
settings.resetKeyStoreError: Could not reset the key store.
settings.deleteAllDescription: This permanently removes conversations, settings and stored API keys from this device. It cannot be undone.
settings.keyNeverRendered: For your security, saved keys are never displayed in the app.
audit.title: Audit log
placeholder.tasks: Scheduled tasks will appear here in Phase 6.
placeholder.skills: Local skills will appear here in Phase 4.
browser.takeoverHelp: Complete sign-in, CAPTCHA or 2FA in the visible browser window. The assistant will not type secrets.
browser.takeoverLine: You have taken control of the browser.
browser.resumeLine: The assistant has resumed control of the browser.
browser.domainsHelp: Exact hosts only. Subdomains must be added explicitly. Do not use loopback hosts in normal use.
browser.invalidDomain: Enter a bare hostname such as example.com.
browser.restartError: Could not restart the managed browser.
tone.title: Tone
tone.help: Sets the style of assistant replies.
memory.title: Memory
memory.help: Memories are facts and preferences the assistant can recall. Disabling one hides it from the model without deleting it.
memory.chatSourceNote: Memories saved during chat use source “chat”.
skills.title: Skills
skills.help: Skills are Markdown instructions the model may read. They are never scripts and never run code.
desktop.untrusted: Content in controlled windows is untrusted data.
desktop.takeoverHelp: Complete sign-in, CAPTCHA or 2FA in the visible Windows app. The assistant will never type secrets.
desktop.takeoverLine: You have taken control of the desktop.
desktop.resumeLine: The assistant has resumed control of the desktop.
desktop.title: Window title
desktop.help: Exact title match only. With no entries, desktop tools are unavailable. Windows only. The assistant never gets a shell, and fields that look like secrets are refused.
desktop.invalidTitle: Enter a window title of at most 300 characters.
tasks.title: Scheduled tasks
tasks.help: Run prompts on a schedule. WiskBot keeps the PC awake while a task runs.
tasks.invalidAt: Choose a valid date and time.
tasks.invalidCron: Enter a cron expression and a time zone.
keepAwake.banner: WiskBot is keeping this PC awake
keepAwake.title: Keep awake
keepAwake.help: The PC stays active while tasks run. A fully sleeping PC runs nothing; turn this off to save battery.
localModels.title: Discovered models
localModels.help: Local providers run on your machine and do not need an API key.
mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.help: You add these servers yourself; WiskBot never downloads anything automatically. Only read-only tools are allowed in this phase. Changing a server's configuration invalidates existing tool approvals.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.targetHelp: For stdio, the command that starts the server. For HTTP, its URL.
mcp.error: Could not add the MCP server
mcp.nameRequired: Enter a server name and target.
mcp.toolsHelp: Tools are grouped by server. Read-only tools can run without extra approval.
